images.filename: StateLibQld 1 99164 Flood damaged railway bridge over the Burdekin River, 1917.jpg
images.caption:
Flood damaged railway bridge over the Burdekin River, 1917.
Flood damaged section of the railway bridge over the Burdekin River in the 1917 floods. A section of the bridge has been swept away leaving twisted and tangled railway lines. Flood debris has been lodged between the sleepers on the decking. A group of observers have gathered on the far side of the bridge.
images.alt:
Flood damaged railway bridge over the Burdekin River, 1917.
Flood damaged section of the railway bridge over the Burdekin River in the 1917 floods. A section of the bridge has been swept away leaving twisted and tangled railway lines. images.filename: StateLibQld 1 84640 Group of men standing on the flooded railway bridge over the Burdekin River, 1917.jpg
images.caption:
Group of men standing on the flooded railway bridge over the Burdekin River, 1917.
A group of sombre looking men, some barefooted and wearing long rain coats, are standing on the railway bridge over the flooded Burdekin River. A small wooden dinghy is visible in the bottom left of the image tied to a partly submerged tree.

images.filename: StateLibQld 1 114896 Motoring in Queensland featuring the Cotton motor car, 1911.jpg
images.caption:
Motoring in Queensland featuring the Cotton motor car, 1911
Series of photographs showing the capabilities of the Cotton motor car. The Cotton is towing a larger car in the metre deep water of the Burdekin River. The Cotton made in Australia has a 24 h.p. engine and a winch attached to the front of the car.

images.filename: StateLibQld 1 148475 Flood debris entangled on the railway bridge over the Burdekin River, 1940.jpg
images.caption:
Flood debris entangled on the railway bridge over the Burdekin River, 1940
Flood debris, including large tree stumps and branches, is entangled on the railway bridge over the flooded Burdekin River. A few men in a small boat assess the condition of the bridge. More debris is littered along the banks of the river. A house is visible in the top right of the photograph.
images.alt:
Flood debris entangled on the railway bridge over the Burdekin River, 1940

images.filename: StateLibQld 1 394517 Anabranch Bridge, Burdekin River.jpg
images.caption:
Anabranch Bridge, Burdekin River
On Rita Island and looking back at Anabranch Bridge. The truck in the front has just crossed the second part of the Burdekin, which you will see is sandy and absolutely dry. In flood time the river stretches from the bank where I stood to snap this to half way up the approach, wider than the Brisbane River. (Description supplied with photograph.).
images.alt:
